title: MyParameters
description:
Implement `MyParameters<T>` — a conditional type that extracts the parameter types of a function as a tuple — without using the built-in `Parameters<T>`.

**Example:**
```ts
type A = MyParameters<(n: number, s: string) => void>  // [number, string]
type B = MyParameters<() => boolean>                   // []
type C = MyParameters<(x: number) => number>           // [number]
```
starter_code: export type MyParameters<T extends (...args: any) => any> = // your type here
solution: export type MyParameters<T extends (...args: any) => any> = T extends (...args: infer P) => any ? P : never;
ai_context: Common mistake: using `infer P` in the return position instead of the args position, or forgetting to spread (`...args: infer P`). The `...args` spread is required to capture all parameters as a tuple.
